Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task at the outset by restricting the simulation to only balls 1–3 and not modeling the full game dynamics with all 100 balls and repeated piston firings until a ball is either ejected or released. This mis-scoping led the Coder to build an inadequate simulation and directly resulted in the incorrect final recommendation (choosing Ball 1 among all 100).
